name: Takeda Karena
source:
Although she has a healthy, supple, strong body, she is concerned about her tanned skin, oversized breasts, muscular build, and thick arms and legs.

She believes that she is unattractive to the opposite sex.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150203020610/http://www.5bit.net/WFG.html]archived official site[/url]]
